profile=[(0,0),(4,0),(5,0.8),(5,9),(4.7,9),(4.7,18),(6,21),(3,26),(0,26)]
body=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(profile).close().revolve(360,(0,0),(0,1))
verts=[(8.5*math.cos(math.radians(60*i)),8.5*math.sin(math.radians(60*i))) for i in range(6)]
hexagon=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=9).polyline(verts).close().extrude(4.5)
result=body.union(hexagon).cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(2.1).extrude(26))
